violations.msg: No input fuse/PTC or TVS on VBUS: a hot-plug spike or short is only limited by U1 (OVP 10.2 V); provisional decision records no protection.
No reverse-battery protection on J2: a reversed pack damages U1/U3; silk polarity warning only (provisional decision).
No current limit/PTC on the 5 V output: a short at J4 relies on U2 internal limit.
Fast-charge timer 51k = 6.8 h nominal (36-60 s/kohm spread: 5.1-8.5 h); fine for 1 A into typical cells, risk only with cells >4 Ah.
